{{Top|leg}}
'''Wetlung''' was a disease that affected the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. [[Miner/Legends|Miners]] were particularly susceptible to the disease.

==Behind the scenes==
The reference to wetlung was present in the profile text for the Quarren miner in ''[[Death in the Undercity]]''. When the adventure was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'', the Quarren miner profile was omitted, including the reference to wetlung.
